title: improve-quant-kernels-int8-fp8-smoothquant-dequant-fusion-kvcache-batching
description: This PR improves quantized inference kernel performance and scheduling across the serving runtime by adding a fused dequantization path for INT8/FP8 models, extending SmoothQuant support in the kernel codepath, and introducing scheduler heuristics that prioritize KV-cache-friendly batching and continuous-batching hot paths. Motivation: customers running large open-weight models on Dedicated and Private deployments reported tail latency regressions and suboptimal throughput after enabling INT8/FP8 kernels; investigation showed dequantization scatter/gather overhead and extra memory copies in the decode loop, plus scheduler choices that broke prefix reuse and prevented KV cache hits. Changes: 1) introduce a fused dequant+matmul path that avoids an intermediate float buffer for common attention and MLP operators, 2) integrate SmoothQuant scale factors into the fused kernel so quant->compute->dequant is a single kernel launch for the hot paths, 3) update the runtime scheduler to prefer batch coalescing for requests with matching KV cache prefixes and to allow continuous-batching to wait up to a configurable micro-bucket when latency SLOs permit, 4) add regression and microbenchmarks for representative Llama/Redwood-family models in INT8/FP8 modes, and 5) add telemetry and feature flags to roll back fusion per-model if numerical diffs exceed thresholds. The description below includes implementation notes, CI history, review discussion, and benchmark summary.

review_comments: Liam: Can we get numerical diff histograms for 1k prompts across several seeds? Please add to the benchmark harness.
Author (Aisha): Added per-layer diff thresholds and histograms; fused path gates on per-model sigma to avoid >1e-3 mean L2 diffs.
Carlos: Kernel launch overhead looks good; can we also avoid an extra memcpy in edge-case of small KV segments? I pushed suggestion to reuse buffer in the coalescer.
Author: Incorporated reuse changes and added a guard for small KV segments to fall back to old path.
Priya: CI failed on macOS-latest due to missing CPU fallback; please add CPU-only path for tests.
Author: Added CPU fallback mocks to the bench harness and updated CI matrix.
Liam: Approving after bench numbers and CI fixed.
Post-merge: Observability added to monitor per-model diff rates and rollouts.
benchmarks_summary: End-to-end inference latency reduced by 12-22% p50 and p95 depending on sequence length; token throughput increased 8-20% on representative 8xA100 Dedicated nodes for Llama-variant models in INT8/FP8 when using fused path. Memory footprint reduced by ~6% due to elimination of intermediate float buffers. SmoothQuant-enabled models saw more consistent accuracy with fused path; per-layer numerical diffs kept below configured thresholds (mean L2 < 1e-4 for most configurations). Bench harness attached and CI runs included regression checks for accuracy and perf.
release_notes: Performance: add fused dequant+compute kernels for INT8/FP8 models; improves latency and throughput when SmoothQuant is enabled. Runtime: scheduler now coalesces batches by KV-cache prefix and supports micro-bucketing for continuous-batching to improve KV hit rate. Telemetry: new per-model diff metrics and feature flags to control fusion rollouts. Impact: should reduce token cost and tail latency on Dedicated and Private deployments for quantized workloads.
